When I checked my suggested edit of this question on Code Review, I thought I must have messed it up, by accidentally pasting something into a code block / code snippet.

Actually I didn't change the code in the question at all, so I think that something must be broken in the revision view on the iOS app.

The preview of the revision looked like this: Here's the full screenhot.

Even after the edit was approved only these UUIDs are shown, instead of the actual source code:

When I double checked it on my computer, it showed everything as expected:

Is this a bug? Or is this by design? Is this related to code snippets or code in general? Can this be fixed?

I'm running the latest version (1.6.6.2) of the Stack Exchange app.

I had this moment yesterday, after editing this question on Code Review. I actually didn't change the code snippet at all, but I found that something must be broken in the revision view on the iOS app.

The preview of the revision looked like this: Here's the full screenhot.

Even after the edit was approved only these UUIDs are shown, instead of the actual source code:

When I double checked it on my computer, it showed everything as expected:

Is this a bug? Or is this by design? Is this related to code snippets or code in general? Can this be fixed?

I'm running the latest version of the Stack Exchange app.
